senses.gloss: Phalakaksha, a Yaksha. § 269 (Vaiśravaṇasabhāv.): II, 10, 398 (among the Yakshas in the palace of Kubera).
Phalgu, name of a tīrtha or of a river. § 370 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 84, 8076 (at Gayā).--§ 377 (Dhaumyatīrthak.): III, 87, 8308 (ºnāmā mahānadī, do.(?), in the east). Cf. Phalgutīrtha.
Phālguna^2 (“named after the nakshatra Phalgunī,” name of a certain month). § 213 (Jatugṛhap.): I, 145, 5767 (ashṭame'hani Rohiṇyāṃ…Pºsya).--§ 759 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 109, 5375 (māse).
Phālgunātmaja (“the son of Phālguna [i.e. Arjuna]”) = Abhimanyu: VII, 1710.

Phalgunī, sg., dual, or pl., name of two nakshatras (pūrvā and uttarā) (v. Su. Si.). § 552 (Goharaṇap.): IV, 44, 1383 (uttarābhyāṃ Pºībhyāṃ nakshatrābhyām ahaṃ divā jāto Himavataḥ pṛshṭhe tena māṃ Phālgunaṃ viduḥ).--§ 746 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 64, 3264 (ºpūrvasamaye…uttarāvishaye, merit of making gifts under the Pºs).--§ 749 (do.): XIII, 89, 4260 (ºīshu…uttarāshu, merit of a śrāddha under this constellation).--§ 759 (do.): XIII, 110, 5390 (sg., description of the cāndravrata).
Phalgutīrtha, name of a tīrtha. § 775 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 166, 7655 (enumeration). Cf. Phalgu.
Phalodaka, a Yaksha. § 269 (Vaiśravaṇasabhāv.): II, 10, 398 (among the Yakshas in the palace of Kubera).
